author: ai
text: In 2025, the United States' net oil exports were 12.6% of its production (U.S. Energy Information Administration, 2025). Its net wheat exports were 36% of production (FAOSTAT, 2024), and Canada was the main supplier of its potash imports, at 88% (FAOSTAT, 2024). The United Kingdom was the main supplier of its major arms imports, at 17% (SIPRI Arms Transfers Database, 2021–2025). It has 342 million people and a GDP of US$30.8 trillion (World Bank, 2025).
